description: Privacy and memory configuration for Maestro claude-mem integration
_comment_enabled: Master switch for memory system. Set to false to completely disable conversation storage.
_comment_retentionDays: Number of days to retain conversation history (1-365). Older conversations are automatically purged. Default: 30 days.
_comment_sanitizeSecrets: Whether to detect and redact sensitive data before storage. Highly recommended to keep enabled.
_comment_sanitizePatterns: Custom regex patterns for additional secret detection. Examples: ['\bCUSTOM_SECRET_\w+', 'ACME_API_[A-Z0-9]{20}']
_comment_excludeAgents: List of agent names whose conversations should not be stored. Example: ['4d-evaluation', 'base-analysis']
_comment_excludeFiles: Glob patterns for files whose contents should not be stored in memory. Protects sensitive files.
_comment_requireConsent: If true, require explicit user consent before storing conversations. Default: false (implicit consent).
